mapper.select: select notice.*, company.company_name as company_name, seeker.username as job_seeker_name, creator.username as creator_name from t_interview_notice notice LEFT JOIN t_company company on notice.company_id = company.company_id LEFT JOIN t_user seeker on notice.job_seeker_id = seeker.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user creator on notice.creator_id = creator.user_id where notice.is_deleted = 0 and notice.id = #{noticeId}

select participant.user_id as userId, user.username as username, user.role as role, user.avatar_url as avatarUrl, participant.participant_type as participantType, participant.is_primary as 'primary' from t_interview_notice_participant participant left join t_user user on participant.user_id = user.user_id where participant.is_deleted = 0 and participant.interview_notice_id = #{noticeId} order by participant.participant_type desc, participant.is_primary desc, participant.id asc
